UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated player account storing username, preferred survivor class, tutorial progress, and match statistics.

uid.description: Firebase Auth user UID matching document ID.

username.description: In-game display username chosen by the player.

email.description: Internal authentication email derived from username.

tutorialCompleted.description: Whether the player has completed or dismissed the interactive first-time tutorial.

matchesPlayed.description: Total matches started or completed by this account (0..1000000).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the account was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Private owner-only player account documents keyed by Firebase Auth UID.
